### TAG-191: writeDefinition unconditional recursion

## Software Notes

One more important design note I should flag (not fixing unilaterally): `writeDefinition` recurses into every `def.contained` entry as its own standalone entity **unconditionally** (line 619), even for rows already consumed by `writeContainedLookupTable`'s case-block path — so FULLADD's `S,U,W[SUM<S> CO<W>]` rows get compiled *twice*: once folded into the outer case statement, and again as a separate, empty-ported, semantically pointless standalone entity. My fill-declaration fix keeps that second copy from throwing an undeclared-signal error, but it doesn't address whether those redundant entities should exist at all. Flagging it rather than silently changing that control flow, since it's a real behavior decision.
